Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Coq.Structures.Orders.

Require Import Stdlib.Init.Sumbool.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Module Usage.

Parameter usage : Set.

Parameter Irr : usage.

Parameter Lin : usage.

Parameter qeqb  : usage -> usage -> bool.

Parameter qleb  : usage -> usage -> bool.

Parameter qplus : usage -> usage -> usage.

Parameter qmul  : usage -> usage -> usage.

Definition t := usage.

Definition eq := @Logic.eq usage.

Definition eqb  := qeqb.

Parameter q_eq_dec : forall (A : usage) (B : usage), { A = B } + { not (A = B) }.

Instance equ  : @EqDec_eq usage := q_eq_dec.

Parameter eqb_eq : forall (n m : usage), qeqb n m = true <-> n = m.

Definition eq_equiv : Equivalence (@Logic.eq usage) := eq_equivalence.

Definition eq_dec := q_eq_dec.

Include BackportEq.

Definition size_usage : usage -> nat := fun _ => 1%nat.

Declare Scope usage_scope.

Bind Scope usage_scope with usage.

Local Open Scope usage_scope.

Infix "=?" := qeqb (at level 70) : usage_scope.

Infix "<=?" := qleb (at level 70) : usage_scope.

Notation "q1 <= q2" := (is_true (qleb q1 q2)) (at level 70)  : usage_scope.

Notation "0" := Irr : usage_scope.

Notation "1" := Lin : usage_scope.

Notation "x + y"  := (qplus x y) : usage_scope.

Notation "x * y " := (qmul x y)  : usage_scope.

Parameter qplus_0_l : forall x, 0 + x = x.

Parameter qmul_0_l : forall x, 0 * x = 0.

Parameter qplus_comm : forall (n m : usage), n + m = m + n.

Parameter qplus_assoc : forall (n m p : usage), n + (m + p) = (n + m) + p.

Parameter qmul_1_l : forall n, 1*n = n.

Parameter qmul_assoc : forall n m p, n*(m*p) = (n*m)*p.

Parameter distr_l : forall n m p, (n + m)*p = n*p + m*p.

Parameter qmul_0_r : forall x, x * 0 = 0.

Parameter qmul_1_r : forall n, n*1 = n.

Parameter distr_r : forall n m p, p * (n + m) = p * n + p * m.

Definition leb  := qleb.

Definition le n m := is_true (qleb n m).

Parameter leb_le : forall (n m : usage), (n <=? m) = true <-> n <= m.

Parameter qleb_refl : forall n, is_true (n <=? n).

Parameter qleb_trans: forall m n p, is_true (n <=? m) -> is_true (m <=? p) -> is_true (n <=? p).

Parameter po_semiring1 : forall a b c , a <= b -> a + c <= b + c.

Parameter po_semiring2 : forall a b c , a <= b -> a * c <= b * c.

Parameter po_semiring3 : forall a b c , a <= b -> c * a <= c * b.

End Usage.

Export Usage.

Section UsageCtx.

Variables A : Type.

Local Open Scope usage_scope.

Definition sort_mul (q: usage) (s : usage * A) : usage * A :=
  match s with
  | (q1 , A) => (qmul q q1, A)
  end.

Definition ctx_mul (q : usage) G :=
  map (sort_mul q) G.

Definition add_usage (q : usage) (D: list (var * A)) : list (var * (usage * A)) :=
  map (fun x => (q, x)) D.

Definition ungrade (G: list (var * (usage * A))) : list (var * A) :=
  map snd G.

Fixpoint ctx_plus (G1 G2 : list (var * (usage * A))) : list (var * (usage * A)) :=
  match G1, G2 with
  | nil , nil => nil
  | cons (x , (q1 , A)) G1' , cons (_, (q2, _)) G2' => cons (x, (q1 + q2, A)) (ctx_plus G1' G2')
  | _ , _ => nil
  end.

Inductive ctx : list (atom * A) -> list (atom * (usage * A)) -> Prop :=
 | ctx_nil :
     ctx nil nil
 | ctx_cons : forall D (x:atom) G (q:usage) a,
     ctx D G ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In x (dom  D)  ->
     ctx (x ~ a ++ D ) (x ~ (q,a) ++ G).

Inductive ctx_sub : list (atom * A) -> list (atom * (usage * A))-> list (atom * (usage * A)) -> Prop :=
 | CS_Empty :  ctx_sub  nil   nil   nil
 | CS_ConsTm : forall D (x:atom) (a:A) G1 (q1:usage) G2 q2,
     ( q1  <=  q2 )  ->
     ctx_sub D G1 G2 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  D)  ->
     ctx_sub (x ~ a ++ D) (x ~ (q1 ,a) ++ G1) (x ~ (q2,a) ++ G2).

End UsageCtx.

Section UsageList.

Local Open Scope usage_scope.

Fixpoint oplus (G1 G2 : list usage) : list usage :=
  match G1, G2 with
  | nil , nil => nil
  | cons q1  G1' , cons q2 G2' => cons (q1 + q2) (oplus G1' G2')
  | _ , _ => nil
  end.

Definition ozero {A} (G : list A) : list usage :=
  List.map (fun _ => 0) G.

Definition Qs {A} (h : list (atom * (usage * A))) : list usage :=
  List.map (fun x => match x with | (_,(u, _)) => u end) h.

End UsageList.

Arguments sort_mul {_}.

Arguments ctx_mul {_}.

Arguments ctx_plus {_}.

Arguments ctx {_}.

Arguments ctx_sub {_}.

Arguments add_usage {_}.

Arguments ungrade {_}.

# 162 — GraD dependent type safety

## Task

Show preservation and progress for the supplied graded dependent calculus, using its given semiring and conversion interface.

Prove all of the following declarations in `Task.v`:

- `preservation`
- `progress`

## Input

- `input/Task.v` is the target file; in the proof workspace, it is `Task.v`.
- Any other supplied `.v` files provide support definitions. Use `_CoqProject` for the source list and library mappings.
- Rocq version: 9.1.0. Local prerequisites: Metalib.

The project already includes the listed dependencies; do not install anything for the proof run.

## Rules

- Edit only `Task.v` in the submitted solution. You may add helper definitions and lemmas there. Keep all supplied definitions and target names, statements, and hypotheses unchanged. Do not change support files or `_CoqProject`.
- Do not use `Admitted`, `admit`, or `Abort` in the submitted solution. Do not add axioms or new global assumptions (including via `Axiom`, `Parameter`, or `Conjecture`), disable kernel checks (such as guard, positivity, or universe checking), or use equivalent shortcuts.
- Work offline. Use only the supplied input and permitted local libraries. Do not look up, copy, or import an existing proof of any target.

## Deliverable

A completed `Task.v` that compiles with Rocq using the supplied project configuration, with every listed target proved and no open goals.

To verify, run `make` from the project root. All project dependencies are included.

  | (a_Spread a b B) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b) \u (fv_tm_tm B)
end.

Definition fv_tm_sort (sort5:sort) : vars :=
  match sort5 with
  | (Tm A) => (fv_tm_tm A)
end.

Fixpoint subst_tm_tm (a5:tm) (x5:tmvar) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6} : tm :=
  match a_6 with
  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
  | (a_letunitB a b B) => a_letunitB (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_Pi q A B) => a_Pi q (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_Lam q A a) => a_Lam q (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_App a b) => a_App (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_Box q A) => a_Box q (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A)
  | (a_LetBoxB a b B) => a_LetBoxB (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
  | a_Type => a_Type
  | (a_Var_b nat) => a_Var_b nat
  | (a_Var_f x) => (if eq_var x x5 then a5 else (a_Var_f x))
  | (a_box q a) => a_box q (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Let a b) => a_Let (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_Sum A1 A2) => a_Sum (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A1) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A2)
  | (a_Inj1 a) => a_Inj1 (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Inj2 a) => a_Inj2 (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Case q a b1 b2 B) => a_Case q (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b1) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b2) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_Sigma q A B) => a_Sigma q (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_Tensor a b) => a_Tensor (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_Spread a b B) => a_Spread (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
end.

Definition subst_tm_sort (a5:tm) (x5:tmvar) (sort5:sort) : sort :=
  match sort5 with
  | (Tm A) => Tm (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A)
end.

Parameter Beta : tm -> tm -> Prop.

Local Open Scope usage_scope.

Fixpoint close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (n1 : nat) (x1 : tmvar) (a1 : tm) {struct a1} : tm :=
  match a1 with
    | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
    | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
    | a_letunitB a2 b1 B1 => a_letunitB (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 B1)
    | a_Pi q1 A1 B1 => a_Pi q1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
    | a_Lam q1 A1 a2 => a_Lam q1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 a2)
    | a_App a2 b1 => a_App (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
    | a_Box q1 A1 => a_Box q1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1)
    | a_LetBoxB a2 b1 B1 => a_LetBoxB (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 b1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 B1)
    | a_Type => a_Type
    | a_Var_f x2 => if (x1 == x2) then (a_Var_b n1) else (a_Var_f x2)
    | a_Var_b n2 => if (lt_ge_dec n2 n1) then (a_Var_b n2) else (a_Var_b (S n2))
    | a_box q1 a2 => a_box q1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Let a2 b1 => a_Let (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 b1)
    | a_Sum A1 A2 => a_Sum (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A2)
    | a_Inj1 a2 => a_Inj1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Inj2 a2 => a_Inj2 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Case q1 a2 b1 b2 B1 => a_Case q1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 B1)
    | a_Sigma q1 A1 B1 => a_Sigma q1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
    | a_Tensor a2 b1 => a_Tensor (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
    | a_Spread a2 b1 B1 => a_Spread (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 b1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 B1)
  end.

Definition close_tm_wrt_tm x1 a1 := close_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 x1 a1.

Inductive Step : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | S_AppCong : forall (a b a':tm),
     lc_tm b ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_App a b) (a_App a' b)
 | S_Beta : forall (q:usage) (A a b:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Lam q A a) ->
     lc_tm b ->
     Step (a_App  ( (a_Lam q A a) )  b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a   b )
 | S_UnitCong : forall (a b B a':tm),
     lc_tm b ->
     lc_tm B ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_letunitB a b B) (a_letunitB a' b B)
 | S_UnitBeta : forall (b B:tm),
     lc_tm B ->
     lc_tm b ->
     Step (a_letunitB a_TmUnit b B) b
 | S_BoxCong : forall (a b B a':tm),
     lc_tm (a_LetBoxB a b B) ->
     lc_tm B ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_LetBoxB a b B) (a_LetBoxB a' b B)
 | S_BoxBeta : forall (q:usage) (a b B:tm),
     lc_tm (a_LetBoxB (a_box q a) b B) ->
     lc_tm B ->
     lc_tm a ->
     Step (a_LetBoxB (a_box q a) b B)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  b   a )
 | S_CaseCong : forall (q:usage) (a b1 b2 B a':tm),
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm b2 ->
     lc_tm B ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_Case q a b1 b2 B) (a_Case q a' b1 b2 B)
 | S_Case1Beta : forall (q:usage) (a b1 b2 B:tm),
     lc_tm b2 ->
     lc_tm B ->
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm a ->
     Step (a_Case q  ( (a_Inj1 a) )  b1 b2 B) (a_App b1 a)
 | S_Case2Beta : forall (q:usage) (a b1 b2 B:tm),
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm B ->
     lc_tm b2 ->
     lc_tm a ->
     Step (a_Case q  ( (a_Inj2 a) )  b1 b2 B) (a_App b2 a)
 | S_SpreadCong : forall (a b B a':tm),
     lc_tm (a_Spread a b B) ->
     lc_tm B ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_Spread a b B) (a_Spread a' b B)
 | S_SpreadBeta : forall (a0 a1 b B:tm),
     lc_tm (a_Spread (a_Tensor a0 a1) b B) ->
     lc_tm B ->
     lc_tm a0 ->
     lc_tm a1 ->
     Step (a_Spread (a_Tensor a0 a1) b B) (a_App  (open_tm_wrt_tm  b   a0 )  a1).

Inductive Typing : D -> context -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | T_sub : forall (D5:D) (G2:context) (a A:tm) (G1:context),
     Typing D5 G1 a A ->
      ctx_sub  D5   G1   G2  ->
     Typing D5 G2 a A
 | T_type :
     Typing  nil   nil  a_Type a_Type
 | T_var : forall (D5:D) (x:tmvar) (A:tm) (G:context),
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  D5 )  ->
     Typing D5 G A a_Type ->
     Typing  (  ( x  ~ Tm A )  ++ D5 )   (  ( x ~(  1  ,Tm  A ))  ++   (ctx_mul   0    G )   )  (a_Var_f x) A
 | T_weak : forall (D5:D) (x:tmvar) (A:tm) (G1:context) (a B:tm) (G2:context),
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  D5 )  ->
     Typing D5 G1 a B ->
     Typing D5 G2 A a_Type ->
     Typing  (  ( x  ~ Tm A )  ++ D5 )   (  ( x ~(  0  ,Tm  A ))  ++ G1 )  a B
 | T_pi : forall (L:vars) (D5:D) (G1 G2:context) (q:usage) (A B:tm) (r:usage),
     Typing D5 G1 A a_Type ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x  ~ Tm A )  ++ D5 )   (  ( x ~( r ,Tm  A ))  ++ G2 )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  a_Type )  ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_plus  G1   G2 )  (a_Pi q A B) a_Type
 | T_lam : forall (L:vars) (D5:D) (G1:context) (q:usage) (A a B:tm) (G2:context),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x  ~ Tm A )  ++ D5 )   (  ( x ~( q ,Tm  A ))  ++ G1 )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Typing D5 G2 A a_Type ->
     Typing D5 G1 (a_Lam q A a) (a_Pi q A B)
 | T_app : forall (D5:D) (G1:context) (q:usage) (G2:context) (a b B A:tm),
     Typing D5 G1 a (a_Pi q A B) ->
     Typing D5 G2 b A ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_plus  G1     (ctx_mul  q   G2 )   )  (a_App a b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   b )
 | T_conv : forall (D5:D) (G1:context) (a B A:tm) (G2:context),
     Typing D5 G1 a A ->
     Typing D5 G2 B a_Type ->
      Beta  A   B  ->
     Typing D5 G1 a B
 | T_unit :
     Typing  nil   nil  a_TmUnit a_TyUnit
 | T_Unit :
     Typing  nil   nil  a_TyUnit a_Type
 | T_UnitE : forall (L:vars) (D5:D) (G1 G2:context) (a b:tm) (r:usage) (B B1:tm) (G3:context),
     Typing D5 G1 a a_TyUnit ->
      B1 =  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a_TmUnit )   ->
     Typing D5 G2 b B1 ->
      ( forall y , y \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( y  ~ Tm a_TyUnit )  ++ D5 )   (  ( y ~( r ,Tm  a_TyUnit ))  ++ G3 )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f y) )  a_Type )  ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_plus  G1   G2 )  (a_letunitB a b  ( (a_Lam r a_TyUnit B) ) )  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_Box : forall (D5:D) (G:context) (q:usage) (A:tm),
     Typing D5 G A a_Type ->
     Typing D5 G (a_Box q A) a_Type
 | T_box : forall (D5:D) (q:usage) (G:context) (a A:tm),
     Typing D5 G a A ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_mul  q   G )  (a_box q a) (a_Box q A)
 | T_letbox : forall (L:vars) (D5:D) (G1 G2:context) (a b:tm) (r q:usage) (A B:tm) (G3:context),
     Typing D5 G1 a (a_Box q A) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x  ~ Tm A )  ++ D5 )   (  ( x ~( q ,Tm  A ))  ++ G2 )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_box q (a_Var_f x)) )  )  ->
      ( forall y , y \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( y  ~ Tm (a_Box q A) )  ++ D5 )   (  ( y ~( r ,Tm  (a_Box q A) ))  ++ G3 )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f y) )  a_Type )  ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_plus  G1   G2 )  (a_LetBoxB a b  ( (a_Lam r (a_Box q A) B) ) )  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_sum : forall (D5:D) (G1 G2:context) (A1 A2:tm),
     Typing D5 G1 A1 a_Type ->
     Typing D5 G2 A2 a_Type ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_plus  G1   G2 )  (a_Sum A1 A2) a_Type
 | T_inj1 : forall (D5:D) (G:context) (a A1 A2:tm) (G1:context),
     Typing D5 G a A1 ->
     Typing D5 G1 A2 a_Type ->
     Typing D5 G (a_Inj1 a) (a_Sum A1 A2)
 | T_inj2 : forall (D5:D) (G:context) (a A1 A2:tm) (G1:context),
     Typing D5 G a A2 ->
     Typing D5 G1 A1 a_Type ->
     Typing D5 G (a_Inj2 a) (a_Sum A1 A2)
 | T_case : forall (L:vars) (D5:D) (q:usage) (G1 G2:context) (a b1 b2:tm) (r:usage) (A1 A2 B B1 B2:tm) (G3:context),
      (  1   <=  q )  ->
     Typing D5 G1 a (a_Sum A1 A2) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  ->   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )  =   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_Inj1 (a_Var_f x)) )    )  ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  ->   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  =   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_Inj2 (a_Var_f x)) )    )  ->
     Typing D5 G2 b1 (a_Pi q A1 B1) ->
     Typing D5 G2 b2 (a_Pi q A2 B2) ->
      ( forall y , y \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( y  ~ Tm (a_Sum A1 A2) )  ++ D5 )   (  ( y ~( r ,Tm  (a_Sum A1 A2) ))  ++ G3 )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f y) )  a_Type )  ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_plus    (ctx_mul  q   G1 )     G2 )  (a_Case q a b1 b2  ( (a_Lam r (a_Sum A1 A2) B) ) )  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_Sigma : forall (L:vars) (D5:D) (G1 G2:context) (q:usage) (A B:tm) (r:usage),
     Typing D5 G1 A a_Type ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x  ~ Tm A )  ++ D5 )   (  ( x ~( r ,Tm  A ))  ++ G2 )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  a_Type )  ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_plus  G1   G2 )  (a_Sigma q A B) a_Type
 | T_Tensor : forall (L:vars) (D5:D) (q:usage) (G1 G2:context) (a b A B:tm) (G3:context) (r:usage),
     Typing D5 G1 a A ->
     Typing D5 G2 b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )  ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x  ~ Tm A )  ++ D5 )   (  ( x ~( r ,Tm  A ))  ++ G3 )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  a_Type )  ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_plus    (ctx_mul  q   G1 )     G2 )  (a_Tensor a b) (a_Sigma q A B)
 | T_Spread : forall (L:vars) (D5:D) (G1 G2:context) (a b:tm) (r:usage) (A B:tm) (q:usage) (A1 A2:tm) (G3:context),
      A = (a_Sigma q A1 A2)  ->
     Typing D5 G1 a A ->
      ( forall x , x \notin L ->
        forall y, y \notin L \u {{x}} ->
           Typing  ((x ~ Tm A1) ++ D5) ((x ~( q ,Tm A1 )) ++ G2 ) (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x))
               (a_Pi 1 (open_tm_wrt_tm A2 (a_Var_f x))
                     (close_tm_wrt_tm y (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Tensor (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f y))))))  ->
      ( forall y , y \notin L -> Typing (y ~ Tm A ++ D5)  ((y ~(r , Tm A)) ++ G3)  (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f y)) a_Type)  ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_plus G1 G2)  (a_Spread a b  (a_Lam r A B))  (open_tm_wrt_tm B a) .

From Stdlib Require Import Lia.

Local Open Scope usage_scope.

(* Opening removes one de Bruijn level, so indices above it decrease. *)
Fixpoint scoped (k : nat) (a : tm) : Prop :=
  match a with
  | a_Var_b n => (n < k)%nat
  | a_Pi _ A B | a_Lam _ A B | a_Sigma _ A B =>
      scoped k A /\\ scoped (S k) B
  | a_LetBoxB a b B | a_Spread a b B =>
      scoped k a /\\ scoped (S k) b /\\ scoped k B
  | a_Let a b => scoped k a /\\ scoped (S k) b
  | a_letunitB a b B => scoped k a /\\ scoped k b /\\ scoped k B
  | a_App a b | a_Sum a b | a_Tensor a b => scoped k a /\\ scoped k b
  | a_Box _ a | a_box _ a | a_Inj1 a | a_Inj2 a => scoped k a
  | a_Case _ a b c B => scoped k a /\\ scoped k b /\\ scoped k c /\\ scoped k B
  | _ => True
  end.

Lemma scoped_open_inv : forall a k u,
  scoped k (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k u a) -> scoped (S k) a.
Proof.
  induction a; simpl; intros; try firstorder.
  destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n0 k) as [[?|?]|?]; simpl in *; lia.
Qed.

Lemma scoped_open : forall a k u,
  scoped (S k) a -> scoped k u -> scoped k (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k u a).
Proof.
  assert (mono : forall a j k, scoped j a -> (j <= k)%nat -> scoped k a).
  { induction a; simpl; intros; try solve [eauto 7 with arith | lia | firstorder eauto with arith]. }
  induction a; simpl; intros;
    try solve [firstorder eauto using Nat.le_succ_diag_r].
  destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n0 k) as [[?|?]|?]; simpl in *; auto; lia.
Qed.

Lemma scoped_lc : forall a, scoped 0 a -> lc_tm a.
Proof.
  enough (H : forall a k, scoped k a ->
    forall f : nat -> var, lc_tm
      ((fix opens k a := match k with
         | O => a
         | S j => opens j (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec j (a_Var_f (f j)) a)
         end) k a)).
  { intros; exact (H a 0 H0 (fun _ => AtomSetImpl.choose {} |> fun _ => tt)). }
Abort.
EOF

Lemma lc_scoped : forall a, lc_tm a -> scoped 0 a.
Proof.
  induction 1; simpl; try tauto;
    repeat split; auto;
    eapply scoped_open_inv; eauto.
Qed.

Fixpoint tm_size (a : tm) : nat :=
  match a with
  | a_Pi _ A B | a_Lam _ A B | a_Sigma _ A B
  | a_Let a b | a_App a b | a_Sum a b | a_Tensor a b => S (tm_size a + tm_size b)%nat
  | a_LetBoxB a b B | a_Spread a b B | a_letunitB a b B =>
       S (tm_size a + tm_size b + tm_size B)%nat
  | a_Box _ a | a_box _ a | a_Inj1 a | a_Inj2 a => S (tm_size a)
  | a_Case _ a b c B => S (tm_size a + tm_size b + tm_size c + tm_size B)%nat
  | _ => 1%nat
  end.

Lemma tm_size_open_var : forall a k x,
  tm_size (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) a) = tm_size a.
Proof.
  induction a; simpl; intros; try solve [f_equal; eauto].
  match goal with |- context [lt_eq_lt_dec ?i ?j] => destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec i j) as [[?|?]|?] end; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma scoped_lc : forall a, scoped 0 a -> lc_tm a.
Proof.
  assert (H : forall n a, (tm_size a < n)%nat -> scoped 0 a -> lc_tm a).
  { induction n; intros a Hn Ha; [lia|].
    destruct a; simpl in *; try lia; decompose [and] Ha; constructor;
      try solve [apply IHn; [lia|assumption]];
      intros x; unfold open_tm_wrt_tm; apply IHn;
      [rewrite tm_size_open_var; lia | apply scoped_open; simpl; assumption || exact I]. }
  intros; eapply H; [apply Nat.lt_succ_diag_r|eassumption].
Qed.

Lemma open_scoped_id : forall a j k u,
  scoped j a -> (j <= k)%nat -> open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k u a = a.
Proof.
  induction a; simpl; intros; try solve [f_equal; firstorder eauto with arith].
  match goal with |- context [lt_eq_lt_dec ?i ?j] => destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec i j) as [[?|?]|?] end; auto; lia.

(* Usage vectors, indexed by the names in an ungraded context. *)
Fixpoint grade (G : context) (x : atom) : usage :=
  match G with
  | nil => 0
  | (y,(r,_)) :: G => if x == y then r else grade G x
  end.

Definition pack (E : D) (f : atom -> usage) : context :=
  List.map (fun p => (fst p, (f (fst p), snd p))) E.

Lemma pack_ext : forall E f g,
  (forall x, x "'`in` dom E -> f x = g x) -> pack E f = pack E g.
Proof.
  induction E as [|[x A] E IH]; simpl; intros; auto.
  f_equal; [f_equal; f_equal|apply IH]; intros; apply H; fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_pack : forall E G, ctx E G -> pack E (grade G) = G.
Proof.
  induction 1; auto. simpl. destruct (x == x); [|congruence].
  f_equal. rewrite <- IHctx at 2. apply pack_ext.
  intros y Hy. destruct (y == x); subst; [contradiction|reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma grade_fresh : forall E G x, ctx E G -> x `notin` dom E -> grade G x = 0.
Proof.
  induction 1; simpl; intros; auto.
  destruct (x == x0); subst; [exfalso; fsetdec|apply IHctx; fsetdec].
Qed.

Lemma pack_plus : forall E f g,
  ctx_plus (pack E f) (pack E g) = pack E (fun x => f x + g x).
Proof. induction E as [|[x A] E IH]; simpl; intros; auto; now rewrite IH. Qed.

Lemma pack_mul : forall E f q,
  ctx_mul q (pack E f) = pack E (fun x => q * f x).
Proof. induction E as [|[x A] E IH]; simpl; intros; auto; now rewrite IH. Qed.

Lemma grade_plus : forall E G H x, ctx E G -> ctx E H ->
  grade (ctx_plus G H) x = grade G x + grade H x.
Proof.
  induction 1; inversion 1; subst; simpl; [now rewrite qplus_0_l|].
  destruct (x == x0); auto.
Qed.

Lemma grade_mul : forall G q x, grade (ctx_mul q G) x = q * grade G x.
Proof.
  induction G as [|[y [r A]] G IH]; simpl; intros; [now rewrite qmul_0_r|].
  destruct (x == y); auto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_add : forall E G H, ctx E G -> ctx E H -> ctx E (ctx_plus G H).
Proof. induction 1; inversion 1; subst; simpl; constructor; auto. Qed.

Lemma ctx_scale : forall E G q, ctx E G -> ctx E (ctx_mul q G).
Proof. induction 1; simpl; constructor; auto. Qed.

Lemma ctx_sub_left : forall E G H, ctx_sub E G H -> ctx E G.
Proof. induction 1; constructor; auto. Qed.

Lemma ctx_sub_right : forall E G H, ctx_sub E G H -> ctx E H.
Proof. induction 1; constructor; auto. Qed.

Lemma grade_sub : forall E G H x, ctx_sub E G H -> grade G x <= grade H x.
Proof.
  induction 1; simpl; [apply qleb_refl|]; destruct (x == x0); auto.
Qed.

Lemma pack_sub : forall E G f g, ctx E G ->
  (forall x, x `in` dom E -> f x <= g x) ->
  ctx_sub E (pack E f) (pack E g).
Proof.
  induction 1; simpl; intros; constructor; auto;
    [apply H1 | apply IHctx]; intros; apply H1 || idtac; fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma plus_0_r : forall q, q + 0 = q.
Proof. intros; rewrite qplus_comm; apply qplus_0_l. Qed.

Lemma usage_interchange : forall f g h k,
  (f + g) + (h + k) = (f + h) + (g + k).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite <- !qplus_assoc. f_equal.
  rewrite (qplus_assoc g h k), (qplus_comm g h), <- qplus_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_plus_comm : forall E G H, ctx E G -> ctx E H ->
  ctx_plus G H = ctx_plus H G.
Proof.
  intros E G H HG HH. rewrite <- (ctx_pack _ _ HG), <- (ctx_pack _ _ HH), !pack_plus.

Qed.

Proof.
  intros E G H q HG HH Hq.
  rewrite <- (ctx_pack _ _ HG), <- (ctx_pack _ _ HH), pack_mul, !pack_plus.
  eapply pack_sub; [exact HG|]. intros.
  apply po_semiring1. rewrite <- (qmul_1_l (grade G x)) at 1.
  apply po_semiring2; assumption.
Qed.

Proof.
  induction 1; eauto using ctx, ctx_add, ctx_scale, ctx_sub_right.

      let z := fresh "z" in fresh_atom z L; specialize (H z ltac:(assumption));
      inversion H; subst; eauto using ctx_add
  end.

Ltac split_typing_ih :=
  repeat match goal with

  end.

Ltac cofinite_component :=

  let x := fresh \"x\" in let Fx := fresh \"Fx\" in intros x Fx;
  match goal with
  | H : forall z, z \\notin _ -> _ /\\ _ |- _ => destruct (H x Fx); assumption
  | H : forall z, z \\notin ?L -> forall y, y \\notin _ -> _ /\\ _ |- _ =>

  end.

Lemma pack_lift : forall E G x r A C,
  x \\notin dom E ->
  pack ((x,Tm C)::E) (grade ((x,(r,Tm A))::G)) =
  (x,(r,Tm C)) :: pack E (grade G).
Proof.
  intros. simpl. destruct (x == x); [|congruence].
  f_equal. apply pack_ext; intros y Hy.
  destruct (y == x); subst; [contradiction|reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma pack_insert_zero : forall E G x A,
  grade G x = 0 ->
  pack ((x,Tm A)::E) (grade G) = (x,(0,Tm A)) :: pack E (grade G).
Proof. intros; simpl; now rewrite H. Qed.

(* An embedding can insert a declaration or replace its type by a convertible
   type. Retained declarations are checked again in the transformed tail. *)
Inductive env_embed : D -> D -> Prop :=
| emb_nil : env_embed nil nil
| emb_insert : forall E F x A G,
    env_embed E F -> x \\notin dom F -> Typing F G A a_Type ->
    env_embed E ((x,Tm A)::F)
| emb_keep : forall E F x A,
    env_embed E F -> x \\notin dom F ->
    env_embed ((x,Tm A)::E) ((x,Tm A)::F)
| emb_conv : forall E F x A C G,
    env_embed E F -> x \\notin dom F -> Typing F G C a_Type -> Beta C A ->
    env_embed ((x,Tm A)::E) ((x,Tm C)::F).

Lemma embed_refl : forall E G, ctx E G -> env_embed E E.
Proof. induction 1; destruct a; constructor; auto. Qed.

Lemma embed_dom : forall E F, env_embed E F ->
  forall x, x \\notin dom F -> x \\notin dom E.
Proof. induction 1; simpl in *; intros; try fsetdec. Qed.

Lemma embed_ctx : forall E F, env_embed E F -> ctx F (pack F (fun _ => 0)).
Proof. induction 1; simpl; constructor; auto. Qed.

Lemma embed_constant : forall E F a A,
  env_embed E F -> E = nil -> Typing nil nil a A ->
  Typing F (pack F (fun _ => 0)) a A.
Proof.
  induction 1; intros He T; inversion He; subst; simpl; eauto using T_weak.
Qed.

Lemma embed_var : forall E F G x A,
  env_embed ((x,Tm A)::E) F ->
  x \\notin dom E -> Typing E G A a_Type ->
  (forall F, env_embed E F -> Typing F (pack F (grade G)) A a_Type) ->
  Typing F (pack F (grade ((x,(1,Tm A))::ctx_mul 0 G))) (a_Var_f x) A.
Proof.
  intros E F G x A H. remember ((x,Tm A)::E) as Src eqn:He.
  induction H; inversion He; subst; intros Fx TA IH.
  - rewrite pack_insert_zero.
    + eapply T_weak; eauto.
    + eapply grade_fresh.
      * constructor; eauto using ctx_scale, Typing_ctx.
      * eapply embed_dom; eauto.
  - rewrite pack_lift by assumption. rewrite grade_mul_pack.
    apply T_var; auto.
  - rewrite pack_lift by assumption. rewrite grade_mul_pack.
    eapply T_conv.
    + eapply T_var; eassumption.
    + eapply T_weak; eauto.
    + assumption.
Qed.

Definition subst_env (u : tm) (x : atom) (P E : D) : D :=
  List.map (fun p => (fst p, subst_tm_sort u x (snd p))) P ++ E.

Lemma subst_env_dom : forall u x P E,
  dom (subst_env u x P E) [=] dom (P ++ E).
Proof.
  intros u x P. induction P as [|[y [A]] P IH]; simpl; intros; [reflexivity|].
  specialize (IH E). fsetdec.
Qed.

Definition subst_budget (F : D) (x : atom) (U G : context) : context :=
  pack F (fun y => grade G y + grade G x * grade U y).

Lemma budget_plus : forall E F x U G H,
  ctx E G -> ctx E H ->
  subst_budget F x U (ctx_plus G H) =
  ctx_plus (subst_budget F x U G) (subst_budget F x U H).
Proof.
  unfold subst_budget; intros; rewrite pack_plus; apply pack_ext; intros.
  rewrite "'!(grade_plus E) by assumption. rewrite distr_l, usage_interchange. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma budget_mul : forall F x U G q,
  subst_budget F x U (ctx_mul q G) = ctx_mul q (subst_budget F x U G).
Proof.
  unfold subst_budget; intros; rewrite pack_mul; apply pack_ext; intros.
  rewrite !grade_mul, distr_r, qmul_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma budget_sub : forall E F x U G H K,
  ctx F K -> ctx_sub E G H ->
  ctx_sub F (subst_budget F x U G) (subst_budget F x U H).
Proof.
  unfold subst_budget; intros. eapply pack_sub; [eassumption|]. intros.
  eapply qleb_trans.
  - apply po_semiring1. eapply grade_sub; eassumption.
  - rewrite (qplus_comm (grade H x0)), (qplus_comm (grade H x0)).
    apply po_semiring1, po_semiring2. eapply grade_sub; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma budget_keep : forall E F x y U G r A C,
  x <> y -> y '"\\notin dom F -> y \\notin dom E -> ctx E U ->
  subst_budget ((y,Tm C)::F) x U ((y,(r,Tm A))::G) =

    (solve [assumption | ctx_fact | pose proof (Typing_ctx _ _ _ _ Tb) as C; inversion C; auto]).
  exact H.
Qed.

  Typing E U u A ->
  (forall x, x \\notin L ->
    Typing ((x,Tm A)::E) ((x,(r,Tm A))::G)
      (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))) ->
  Typing E (ctx_plus G (ctx_mul r U)) (open_tm_wrt_tm b u) (open_tm_wrt_tm B u).
Proof.
  intros E G U u A b B r L Tu Tb.
  fresh_atom x (L \\u dom E \\u fv_tm_tm b \\u fv_tm_tm B).
  rewrite (open_intro b u x), (open_intro B u x) by set_fresh.
  eapply typing_subst_head; [set_fresh|exact Tu|apply Tb; set_fresh].

  x <> y -> x \\notin dom E ->

  Typing ((y,Tm C)::E) ((y,(r,Tm C))::G) a B ->

Definition components (E : D) (t : tm) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | a_Pi _ A B | a_Sigma _ A B =>
      (exists G, Typing E G A a_Type) /\\
      (exists L r H, forall x, x \\notin L ->
        Typing ((x,Tm A)::E) ((x,(r,Tm A))::H) (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x)) a_Type)

  | a_Sum A B => (exists G, Typing E G A a_Type) /\\ (exists H, Typing E H B a_Type)
  | _ => True
  end.

Lemma ctx_mul_one : forall G : context, ctx_mul 1 G = G.
Proof. induction G as [|[x [r A]] G IH]; simpl; auto. now rewrite qmul_1_l, IH. Qed.

Lemma subst_tensor_motive1 : forall B a x y,
  x <> y -> x \\notin fv_tm_tm B -> lc_tm a ->
  subst_tm_tm a x (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Tensor (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f y))) =
  open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Tensor a (a_Var_f y)).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite subst_open, (subst_fresh B) by assumption.
  change (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Tensor (subst_tm_tm a x (a_Var_f x)) (subst_tm_tm a x (a_Var_f y))) = _).
  now rewrite subst_var_same, subst_var_other.
Qed.

Lemma subst_tensor_motive2 : forall B a b y,
  y \\notin fv_tm_tm B -> y \\notin fv_tm_tm a -> lc_tm b ->
  subst_tm_tm b y (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Tensor a (a_Var_f y))) =
  open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Tensor a b).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite subst_open, (subst_fresh B) by assumption.
  change (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Tensor (subst_tm_tm b y a) (subst_tm_tm b y (a_Var_f y))) = _).
  now rewrite (subst_fresh a), subst_var_same.
Qed.

Lemma preservation_spread_beta : forall E F G a0 a1 b A1 A2 B L q,
  Typing E F (a_Tensor a0 a1) (a_Sigma q A1 A2) ->
  (forall x, x \\notin L -> forall y, y \\notin L \\u {{x}} ->
     Typing ((x,Tm A1)::E) ((x,(q,Tm A1))::G) (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x))
       (a_Pi 1 (open_tm_wrt_tm A2 (a_Var_f x))
         (close_tm_wrt_tm y (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Tensor (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f y)))))) ->
  Typing E (ctx_plus F G) (a_App (open_tm_wrt_tm b a0) a1)
    (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Tensor a0 a1)).
Proof.
  intros E F G a0 a1 b A1 A2 B L q T Tb.
  destruct (typing_introduction _ _ _ _ T (val_tensor a0 a1)) as [J [C [I [Le BC]]]].
  inversion I; subst. clear I.
  match goal with H : Beta (a_Sigma ?r _ _) (a_Sigma ?q _ _) |- _ =>
    pose proof (invert_Beta_a_Sigma0 H); subst r
  end.
  destruct (type_components _ _ _ _ T) as [KA [L' [r [K KB]]]].
  assert (W : exists G0 G1, Typing E G0 a0 A1 /\\
    Typing E G1 a1 (open_tm_wrt_tm A2 a0) /\\ ctx_sub E (ctx_plus (ctx_mul q G0) G1) F).
  { do 2 eexists. split.
    - eapply retype; [eassumption|exact KA|eauto using invert_Beta_a_Sigma1].
    - split; [|exact Le].
      eapply retype; [eassumption|eauto using kind_open, retype, invert_Beta_a_Sigma1|].
      eapply beta_sigma_open; eauto using Typing_lc. }
  destruct W as [G0 [G1 [T0 [T1 LW]]]].
  fresh_atom x (L \\u dom E \\u fv_tm_tm b \\u fv_tm_tm A2 \\u fv_tm_tm B).
  fresh_atom y (L \\u {{x}} \\u fv_tm_tm B \\u fv_tm_tm a0).
  pose proof (Tb x ltac:(set_fresh) y ltac:(set_fresh)) as TF.
  pose proof (typing_subst_head _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ltac:(set_fresh) T0 TF) as S.
  rewrite <- (open_intro b a0 x) in S by set_fresh.
  cbn [subst_tm_tm] in S.
  rewrite <- (open_intro A2 a0 x) in S by set_fresh.
  rewrite subst_close, subst_tensor_motive1 in S by
    (solve [set_fresh | eauto using Typing_lc]).
  pose proof (T_app _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ S T1) as V.
  rewrite open_close, subst_tensor_motive2, ctx_mul_one in V by
    (solve [set_fresh | eauto using Typing_lc]).
  assert (CG : ctx E G).
  { pose proof (Typing_ctx _ _ _ _ TF) as HC. inversion HC; assumption. }
  eapply T_sub; [exact V|].
  rewrite <- (ctx_plus_assoc E G (ctx_mul q G0) G1) by ctx_fact.
  rewrite (ctx_plus_comm E G (ctx_plus (ctx_mul q G0) G1)) by ctx_fact.
  apply ctx_sub_add; auto using ctx_sub_refl.
Qed.

Ltac preserve_dependent original rule :=
  eapply retype;
  [ solve [eapply rule; eassumption || eauto; reflexivity]
  | eapply typing_regular; exact original
  | eapply beta_motive_step; [exact original|eassumption] ].

Theorem preservation: forall D G a A, Typing D G a A -> forall a', Step a a' -> Typing D G a' A.
Proof.
  intros E G a A T. induction T; intros v S;
    try solve [eapply T_sub; eauto | eapply T_weak; eauto | eapply T_conv; eauto];
    inversion S; subst.
  - eapply T_app; eauto.
  - eapply preservation_app_beta; eassumption.
  - assert (Old : Typing D5 (ctx_plus G1 G2) (a_letunitB a b (a_Lam r a_TyUnit B))
        (open_tm_wrt_tm B a)) by (eapply T_UnitE; eauto).
    preserve_dependent Old T_UnitE.
  - eapply preservation_unit_beta; eassumption.
  - assert (Old : Typing D5 (ctx_plus G1 G2) (a_LetBoxB a b (a_Lam r (a_Box q A) B))
        (open_tm_wrt_tm B a)) by (eapply T_letbox; eauto).
    preserve_dependent Old T_letbox.
  - eapply preservation_box_beta; eassumption.
  - assert (Old : Typing D5 (ctx_plus (ctx_mul q G1) G2)
       (a_Case q a b1 b2 (a_Lam r (a_Sum A1 A2) B)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B a))
        by (eapply T_case; eauto).
    preserve_dependent Old T_case.
  - eapply preservation_case1_beta; eassumption.
  - eapply preservation_case2_beta; eassumption.
  - assert (Old : Typing D5 (ctx_plus G1 G2)
        (a_Spread a b (a_Lam r (a_Sigma q A1 A2) B)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B a))
        by (eapply T_Spread; eauto).
    preserve_dependent Old T_Spread.
  - eapply preservation_spread_beta; eassumption.
Qed.

Ltac canonical T V :=
  let G := fresh \"G\" in let A := fresh \"A\" in let I := fresh \"I\" in
  let Le := fresh \"Le\" in let B := fresh \"B\" in
  destruct (typing_introduction _ _ _ _ T V) as [G [A [I [Le B]]]];
  inversion I; subst; clear I;
  match type of B with
  | Beta ?C ?D =>
      let X := fresh \"X\" in
      pose proof (Beta_consistent C D B ltac:(repeat constructor) ltac:(repeat constructor)) as X;
      inversion X; subst; eauto 8
  end.

Lemma canonical_pi : forall E G a q A B,
  Typing E G a (a_Pi q A B) -> value a ->
  exists r C b, a = a_Lam r C b.
Proof. intros E G a q A B T V; canonical T V. Qed.

Lemma canonical_unit : forall E G a,
  Typing E G a a_TyUnit -> value a -> a = a_TmUnit.
Proof. intros E G a T V; canonical T V. Qed.

Lemma canonical_box : forall E G a q A,
  Typing E G a (a_Box q A) -> value a ->
  exists r b, a = a_box r b.
Proof. intros E G a q A T V; canonical T V. Qed.

Lemma canonical_sum : forall E G a A B,
  Typing E G a (a_Sum A B) -> value a ->
  (exists b, a = a_Inj1 b) \\/ (exists b, a = a_Inj2 b).
Proof. intros E G a A B T V; canonical T V. Qed.

Lemma canonical_sigma : forall E G a q A B,
  Typing E G a (a_Sigma q A B) -> value a ->
  exists b c, a = a_Tensor b c.
Proof. intros E G a q A B T V; canonical T V. Qed.

Theorem progress : forall a A,
  Typing nil nil a A -> value a \\/ exists a', Step a a'.
Proof.
  enough (H : forall E G a A, Typing E G a A -> E = nil ->
    value a \\/ exists a', Step a a') by eauto.
  induction 1; intros Eq; subst; try discriminate;
    try solve [auto | left; repeat constructor].
  - destruct (IHTyping1 eq_refl) as [V|[a' S]]; right.
    + destruct (canonical_pi _ _ _ _ _ _ H V) as [r [C [b0 ->]]].
      eexists. apply S_Beta; eauto using Typing_lc.
      pose proof (Typing_lc _ _ _ _ H) as LC. inversion LC; assumption.
    + eexists; eapply S_AppCong; eauto using Typing_lc.
  - destruct (IHTyping1 eq_refl) as [V|[a' S]]; right.
    + pose proof (canonical_unit _ _ _ H V); subst a.
      exists b. apply S_UnitBeta; eauto using Typing_lc.
      eapply Typing_lc. eapply T_lam; eauto using T_Unit.
    + eexists; eapply S_UnitCong; eauto using Typing_lc.
      eapply Typing_lc. eapply T_lam; eauto using T_Unit.
  - assert (LC : lc_tm (a_LetBoxB a b (a_Lam r (a_Box q A) B))).
    { eapply Typing_lc. eapply T_letbox; eassumption. }
    assert (LM : lc_tm (a_Lam r (a_Box q A) B)) by (inversion LC; assumption).
    destruct (IHTyping1 eq_refl) as [V|[a' S]]; right.
    + destruct (canonical_box _ _ _ _ _ H V) as [r' [u ->]].
      eexists; eapply S_BoxBeta; eauto.
      pose proof (Typing_lc _ _ _ _ H) as LU. inversion LU; assumption.
    + eexists; eapply S_BoxCong; eauto.
  - assert (LC : lc_tm (a_Case q a b1 b2 (a_Lam r (a_Sum A1 A2) B))).
    { eapply Typing_lc. eapply T_case; eassumption. }
    inversion LC; subst.
    destruct (IHTyping1 eq_refl) as [V|[a' S]]; right.
    + destruct (canonical_sum _ _ _ _ _ H0 V) as [[u ->]|[u ->]];
        eexists; [eapply S_Case1Beta|eapply S_Case2Beta]; eauto;
        match goal with H : lc_tm (a_Inj1 _) |- _ => inversion H; assumption
                       | H : lc_tm (a_Inj2 _) |- _ => inversion H; assumption end.
    + eexists; eapply S_CaseCong; eauto.
  - assert (LC : lc_tm (a_Spread a b (a_Lam r (a_Sigma q A1 A2) B))).
    { eapply Typing_lc. eapply T_Spread; eauto. }
    assert (LM : lc_tm (a_Lam r (a_Sigma q A1 A2) B)) by (inversion LC; assumption).
    destruct (IHTyping1 eq_refl) as [V|[a' S]]; right.
    + match goal with T : Typing nil _ a (a_Sigma _ _ _) |- _ =>
        destruct (canonical_sigma _ _ _ _ _ _ T V) as [u [w ->]]
      end.
      eexists; eapply S_SpreadBeta; eauto;
        match goal with H : Typing _ _ (a_Tensor _ _) _ |- _ =>
          pose proof (Typing_lc _ _ _ _ H) as LT; inversion LT; assumption end.
    + eexists; eapply S_SpreadCong; eauto.
Qed.

Inductive env_embed : D -> D -> Prop :=
